Seen • Just now
Here’s a simple starting point:
Whiskey — rich and warming; styles include sweeter Bourbon, spicier Rye, and varied Scotch.
Tequila — made from agave; often bright and earthy, with aged versions becoming smoother and richer.
Rum — often associated with Caribbean and South American traditions; it can range from light and easy-mixing to darker, aged styles.
Gin — botanical and aromatic, often with a fresh juniper-led character.
Vodka — clear and neutral in style, making it an easy choice for cocktails.
Brandy — fruit-based and typically smooth, warming, and mellow.
Flaviar carries all of these categories, from familiar classics to craft and small-batch bottles.
